maintenance_led.reason: Sells packaged canned fruits and vegetables, consumable food products to retail, foodservice and industrial buyers, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly from retailers, foodservice and industrial customers; some USDA sales exist but are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own vertically integrated processing and sales of canned vegetables; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Canned vegetables and fruits are largely commodity or private-label goods; retailers can switch suppliers easily on price.
